title: Meet GitAgent: The Docker for AI Agents Solving Fragmentation Between LangChain, AutoGen, and Claude Code

key_discoveries.title: GitAgent Universal Format
key_discoveries.description: Framework-agnostic agent definition spec: agent.yaml + SOUL.md + DUTIES.md + skills/ + tools/ + rules/ + memory/. Define once, export to any major framework via `gitagent export -f [framework]`.

key_discoveries.title: Git-as-Supervision Layer
key_discoveries.description: Agent state changes (memory updates, skill acquisitions) become Git branches and PRs. Human reviewers inspect diffs of personality/memory changes. Behavioral drift reversible via `git revert`.

key_discoveries.title: SOUL.md — Declarative Agent Identity
key_discoveries.description: Replaces scattered Python system prompts with a structured Markdown file defining agent core identity, personality, and tone. Agents can be forked, branched, and shared as open-source repos.

key_discoveries.title: DUTIES.md + SOD Compliance
key_discoveries.description: Defines agent responsibilities and Segregation of Duties (SOD) constraints. `gitagent validate` checks conflict matrix before deployment. Built-in support for FINRA, SEC, Federal Reserve regulations.

key_discoveries.title: Human-Readable Memory as Markdown
key_discoveries.description: Long-term agent memory stored as plain .md files (context.md, dailylog.md) in a memory/ directory — not vector databases. Fully searchable, auditable, and version-controlled.
